slides.title: 2,086 people sent home in one week
slides.body: Ethiopians returned from Saudi Arabia, week to Nov 16, 2026

slides.title: Ethiopians returned from Saudi Arabia in one week
slides.body: 1,664 men, 387 women and 35 children, the Ministry of Women and Social Affairs said (Fana, Nov 16).

slides.title: returned since the operation began on Sept 15, 2025
slides.body: Ministry figures reported by Fana Media Corporation.

slides.title: deported Jan-Mar 2026, up 106% from a year earlier
slides.body: IOM figures reported by The Reporter (Aug 2026). 92% were men; at least 679 were minors.

slides.title: Most come from conflict-hit regions
slides.body: IOM: 36% returned to Tigray, 31% to Amhara and 29% to Oromia, per The Reporter.

slides.title: Reception centres are stretched
slides.body: IOM cited limited capacity at reception centres in Ethiopia and protection risks on the migration route.

slides.title: Returnees need safety, support and dignity.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Fana (MoWSA), Nov 16, 2026; The Reporter (IOM), Aug 2026
